title: LLM
summary: A public command-line and Python interface for interacting with language models, plugins, prompts, embeddings, and logs.
intended_users: Developers and technical users who want scriptable, inspectable access to multiple language-model providers.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Expose changing model providers through stable local command and Python surfaces.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: A provider-specific wrapper is simpler but would couple user workflows to one API and model family.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Use registered models and plugins behind shared interfaces with explicit prompts, options, logs, and storage.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: Plugin and provider flexibility expands configuration, trust, privacy, and compatibility responsibilities.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Review committed CLI, model, plugin, template, embedding, and logging tests without claiming execution.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Revisit plugin and model interfaces when provider capabilities cannot be represented without leaky special cases.

testing_strategy: The repository contains focused tests for commands, models, plugins, prompts, embeddings, schemas, keys, and logging; Finch does not execute them.
security_threat: API keys, prompt content, logs, plugin code, and provider boundaries create concrete trust and privacy risks; controls must be judged only where visible in pinned evidence.
production_limitation: Static review cannot establish model quality, provider behavior, privacy, successful tests, plugin safety, or runtime correctness.
technical_debt: Provider-specific and plugin-specific risk remains dependent on external systems outside the frozen archive.
track_alignment_explanation: AI is essential to the tool, while explicit commands, local logs, templates, options, and provider choice keep the interaction bounded and user-controlled.

ai_disclosure.purposes: No claim is made about upstream AI use; this holdout submission narrative was prepared for calibration without maintainer input.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: A human reviewer froze the reference range before model inference.
